production_rule: No mixture-of-experts fair-value path is used in the live paper champion. Each model must emit the economic object it is designed to estimate and use a matching execution style.
semantic_role: Contract parsing, entity extraction, threshold-family construction and logical relation discovery. Semantic similarity alone must never create a fair probability or trade.

local_factor.rule: Many local factor models are allowed; one PCA per single market is forbidden because PCA requires a cross-section.

graph_hard.rule: Hard event arbitrage requires a Gamma-verified complete active outcome set and full live book revalidation before entry.

external.rule: Universalize the signal interface, not the domain model. Sources remain specialist and point-in-time.

operability_contract.rule: A silent model is a defect. A model may abstain, but it must publish the exact reason distribution and the scheduler must distinguish no alpha, failed data, failed execution and failed risk admission.
operability_contract.aggressiveness: Increase operations by expanding valid edge sources, maker participation, local models and executable relation coverage. Do not manufacture trades by ignoring costs or logical completeness.

scheduler_directive.all_schedulers: Treat V6 model roles and output contracts as authoritative. Research that reintroduces semantic peer averaging, global heterogeneous PCA, midpoint-only hard arbitrage or a live fair-value mixture is non-promotable.
scheduler_directive.alpha_factory: Maintain challengers separately for micro, local_factor, graph_hard, graph_rv, structural and external; rank by executable OOS utility and incremental trade coverage.
scheduler_directive.forward_maker: Optimize micro maker fill EV and adverse selection; also test short-horizon taker forecasts separately.
scheduler_directive.fast_arb: Prioritize executable graph_hard relations and full multi-leg VWAP revalidation.
scheduler_directive.arb_theory: Expand proof-backed implication, exhaustive-event and structural payoff relations, then emit standardized intents.
scheduler_directive.external_intelligence: Produce timestamped specialist probabilities only after point-in-time match validation and OOS evidence.
scheduler_directive.promotion_controller: Promotion must preserve the V6 contracts and require exact-source OOS evidence, cost stress, drawdown control, data health and non-degrading incremental utility.
scheduler_directive.monitoring: Expose model coverage, rejections, emitted bundles, fills and PnL by V6 family and execution mode.
